faq_en: Is regex case-sensitive?
Yes by default. Use i flag to ignore case.
How to match any character?
Use . to match any character except newline. Add s flag to include newlines.
What's the difference between greedy and non-greedy?
Greedy matches as much as possible; non-greedy (with ?) matches as little as possible.

Base64 编码后体积会增加约 33%，因为每 3 字节编码成 4 个 ASCII 字符。
为什么要用 Base64？
主要用于在文本协议中传输二进制数据，如在 JSON、HTML、URL 中嵌入图片。
Base64 是加密吗？
不是加密，只是编码。任何人都可以解码还原原始数据。

Base64 encoding increases size by about 33% as 3 bytes become 4 ASCII characters.
Why use Base64?
Mainly for transmitting binary data in text protocols, e.g., embedding images in JSON, HTML, URLs.
Is Base64 encryption?
No. Base64 is just encoding. Anyone can decode to get original data.

空格编码成 + 还是 %20？

URLs can only contain ASCII characters. Non-ASCII and special symbols need encoding for proper transmission.
Space encoded as + or %20?

What's the difference between encodeURI and encodeURIComponent?
encodeURI doesn't encode URI reserved characters like :/?#[]@!$&'()*+,;=.

MD5 已被破解，不适合密码存储，但文件校验仍广泛使用。
哈希是加密吗？
不是。哈希是单向摘要，无法还原原始数据。加密是双向的，可以解密。
什么是哈希碰撞？
两个不同的输入产生相同的哈希值。好的哈希算法碰撞概率极低。
faq_en: Is MD5 still secure?
MD5 is cryptographically broken, not suitable for passwords, but still widely used for file checksums.
Is hashing encryption?
No. Hashing is one-way digest, original data cannot be recovered. Encryption is two-way and decryptable.
What is hash collision?
Two different inputs producing the same hash. Good hash algorithms have extremely low collision probability.

UUID 会重复吗？

v4 is completely random; v7 has timestamp prefix and can be sorted by creation time, good for database keys.

faq_zh: 什么是 Unix 时间戳？
Unix 时间戳是从 1970年1月1日 UTC 00:00:00 到现在的秒数（或毫秒数）。
为什么有的是 10 位有的是 13 位？
10 位是秒级精度，13 位是毫秒级精度。
2038 年问题是什么？
32 位有符号整数在 2038 年 1 月 19 日会溢出。现在大部分系统已经用 64 位时间戳。
faq_en: What is Unix timestamp?
Unix timestamp is the number of seconds (or milliseconds) since Jan 1, 1970 UTC 00:00:00.
Why 10 digits vs 13 digits?
10 digits = second precision, 13 digits = millisecond precision.
What is the Year 2038 problem?
32-bit signed integers will overflow on Jan 19, 2038. Most systems now use 64-bit timestamps.
